fields.description: Saturating play/save counter: save image word 0. FUN_080017f8 writes 0xFFFFFFFF here on fresh init; ranking insert paths in FUN_0800651c and FUN_08006b50 increment per-table counters with saturation to -1 on overflow. Baseline 0xFFFFFFFF = saturated.
fields.evidence: FUN_080017f8 stores 0xFFFFFFFF at save base word 0 on init (param_1==0 path, *puVar3=uVar9 with uVar9=0xFFFFFFFF, DAT_08001950 base); FUN_0800651c and FUN_08006b50 use saturating +1 counters clamped to -1; file offset 0x2000 holds 0xFFFFFFFF in baseline.
fields.name: save_play_counter

fields.description: 16-bit config word at save base +0x18. FUN_080017f8 writes the constant 3 here (*(u16*)(base+6 words)=3) on init; exact option semantics undocumented in decomp, value preserved as gameplay/config scalar for live-mutation probing.
fields.evidence: FUN_080017f8 writes *(undefined2*)(puVar3+6)=3 with puVar3=DAT_08001950 save base, i.e. save file offset 0x2000+0x18=0x2018; baseline bytes at 0x2018 are 03 00.
fields.name: options_word

fields.description: Fixed table constant 599999 (0x0927BF) in the 32-byte header of score ranking tables T0-T3 (header word 3). Verified NOT a content checksum: table T4 mirrors T3 scores yet stores 0 here. Treated as opaque table data, not a checksum spec.
fields.evidence: FUN_080017f8 copies 5 ranking tables with 0xE8-byte pitch (232 = 32 header + 10x20 records, matching file tables at 0x2048+k*232); file words at 0x2054/0x213C/0x2224/0x230C all read 0x000927BF=599999 while T4 header word at 0x23F4 reads 0 despite identical scores.
fields.name: t0_table_const

fields.description: Default ranker name '!!!' (3x 0x21 plus NUL) of the top entry of score table T0 (first 20-byte record at 0x2068).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800651c ranking insert stores 0x21 three times per new entry (name default) into 20-byte (5-word stride, uVar19*0x14) records, 10 per table; file shows '!!!' every 20 bytes from 0x2068.
fields.name: t0_rank1_name

fields.description: Top score of score table T0: 49900 points. Written as (piVar13+10)[k*5] score word in the 20-byte record.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800651c writes the score total uVar14 at record word 0 ((piVar13+10)[uVar19*5]) with 20-byte stride; file u32 at 0x206C reads 49900, head of the 49900..5000 default ladder.
fields.name: t0_rank1_score

fields.description: Top depth of score table T0: 495 m. Second word of the 20-byte record (param_2 slot).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800651c writes param_2 at record word 1 (piVar13[uVar19*5+0xB]); file u32 at 0x2070 reads 495, head of the 495..50 default ladder.
fields.name: t0_rank1_depth

fields.description: Display rank of the T0 top entry (1-based; 0 = unranked scratch row). Assigned by the rank-order loop over the 10 records.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800651c rank loop writes per-record order bytes with 0x14 stride for all 10 entries (iVar6<10, values 0..9); file byte at record offset +18 reads 1..9 down the table with the 10th row 0.
fields.name: t0_rank1_rank

fields.description: Driller/character id that set the T0 top entry (0..5 roster). Stored alongside rank at record offset +19.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800651c stores the character/mode byte at record offset +0x13 alongside rank (+0x12); FUN_08006b50 6-iteration character loop corroborates a 6-entry roster; file bytes at record +19 across all 150 entries read only 0..5.
fields.name: t0_rank1_driller

fields.description: Top score of score table T1 (second mode table at 0x2150): 79900 points.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800651c per-table base piVar13=DAT_080066c4+param_1*0xE8 (232-byte pitch matches file tables T0..T4 at 0x2048+k*232); file u32 at T1 record 0 score offset 0x2154 reads 79900.
fields.name: t1_rank1_score

fields.description: Top depth of score table T1: 795 m.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800651c writes param_2 at record word 1 for every table (0xE8 pitch); file u32 at 0x2158 reads 795.
fields.name: t1_rank1_depth

fields.description: Top score of score table T2 (third mode table at 0x2238): 149900 points.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800651c 0xE8-pitch table array; file u32 at T2 record 0 score offset 0x223C reads 149900.
fields.name: t2_rank1_score

fields.description: Default ranker name '!!!' of the top entry of the first time-trial table at 0x250C (score/depth words zero, time value at record +12).
fields.evidence: FUN_08006b50 time-table insert stores 0x21 triplets (name default) with 20-byte stride (uVar19*0x14), 10 per table, and zeroes score/depth words; file shows '!!!' every 20 bytes from 0x250C with zero score words.
fields.name: ta_rank1_name

fields.description: Best time value of the first time-trial table: 8500 (lower is better; rank 1 holds the minimum). Unit undocumented; kept as opaque scalar.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006b50 keeps the time comparator in local_28[k*5] parallel to 20-byte records and zeroes score/depth words (piVar9[k*5+6/7]=0); file u32 at record +12 (0x2518) reads 8500, minimum of its column.
fields.name: ta_rank1_time

fields.description: Display rank of the first time-trial top entry (1-based).
fields.evidence: FUN_08006b50 writes rank bytes with 0x14 stride over 10 entries (iVar10<10 loop, *(char*)((int)piVar15+0x12)); file byte at record offset +18 (0x251E) reads 1.
fields.name: ta_rank1_rank

fields.description: Driller/character id of the first time-trial top entry (0..5 roster).
fields.evidence: FUN_08006b50 stores the character byte at record offset +0x13 next to rank; file byte at 0x251F reads 1, within the observed 0..5 range.
fields.name: ta_rank1_driller
